skill.name: brewpage-publish
skill.description: Publish text, Markdown, JSON, files, and built static sites to brewpage.app with explicit sharing choices and local owner-token storage.
skill.summary: Create shareable brewpage.app links for selected content and static sites.
skill.author: kochetkov-ma

security_audit.summary: All 272 static alerts reflect documentation, defensive validation, or expected publishing utilities rather than demonstrated security vulnerabilities. No evidence found of malicious exfiltration or audit-directed prompt injection; uploads intentionally send selected content to brewpage.app after explicit sharing choices. File contents are not scanned for embedded secrets, and unlisted links without passwords remain accessible to anyone holding the link.

content.user_title: Publish Content and Static Sites to Brewpage
content.value_statement: Sharing documents and static site builds often requires a separate hosting workflow. This skill uploads selected content to brewpage.app and returns shareable links after explicit privacy choices.
actual_capabilities: Publish text and Markdown as rendered pages, or publish valid JSON documents.
Upload individual local files through multipart requests.
Package built static directories with an extension allowlist, or inspect supplied ZIP archives before uploading.
Ask for explicit namespace and password choices, with optional passwords read from existing local files.
Set requested retention, site entry, and delivery mode, then return the exact server-provided link.
Save owner tokens in project history with mode 0600 and Git exclusion, while rejecting unsafe history destinations.
limitations: Requires macOS, Linux, or WSL and command-line dependencies; site uploads also need Node.js and archive tools.
Publishes existing static output; it does not build applications or run backend services.
Archive checks inspect names and structure, not embedded secrets inside file contents.
Hosting depends on brewpage.app availability, upload limits, and expiration policies; the requested default retention is 15 days.

use_cases.title: Share Project Documentation
use_cases.description: Publish a selected document or Markdown text with deliberate visibility and optional password protection.

use_cases.title: Review Static Prototypes
use_cases.description: Upload a built static directory while preserving relative asset paths and selecting the intended entry page.

use_cases.title: Distribute Temporary Reports
use_cases.description: Share an approved report file or JSON document with a requested retention period and a saved owner token.

prompt_templates.title: Publish Selected Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Publish the selected text to brewpage.app. Ask me to choose a namespace and password policy before uploading.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a shareable page from text.

prompt_templates.title: Share a Local File
prompt_templates.prompt: Publish the file I select for one day. Use my explicit sharing choices, and preserve the returned URL exactly.

prompt_templates.title: Deploy a Static Build
prompt_templates.prompt: Publish my selected built static directory. Check its entry page, preview sizes, and ask about namespace and password before upload.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Supplied Archive
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect my selected site ZIP and check current limits. Show flagged entries, then wait for my approval of the exact digest before uploading.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: review an archive before publication.

output_examples.input: Publish selected Markdown after I confirm the sharing choices.
output: Owner token saved in private project history, when ownership is returned.

output_examples.input: Publish a built static directory with its chosen entry page.
output: Archive manifest lists selected files, size, entry page, and skipped entries.
Published site: the exact server-provided URL.
Entry page and published file count are reported.

output_examples.input: Inspect a site archive containing a sensitive-looking filename.
output: The manifest identifies flagged entries and the archive review digest.
Confirmation is required. Nothing has been uploaded.

best_practices: Publish reviewed build output and check file contents for embedded secrets before uploading.
Treat unlisted links as shareable, not confidential; use a password file when access must be restricted.
Review flagged archive entries and approve only the displayed digest; keep local owner-token history private.
anti_patterns: Publishing source trees, credentials, or personal data without reviewing the selected content.
Treating an unlisted namespace as authentication or assuming uploaded content will never expire.
Pasting password contents or owner tokens into chat, or approving a changed archive without another review.

faq.question: What content can I publish?
faq.answer: Text, Markdown, JSON, individual files, built static directories, and existing site ZIP archives are supported.

faq.question: Do I need an account?
faq.answer: No account is required to publish. Optional account management and retention extensions depend on brewpage.app.

faq.question: Are private namespaces access-controlled?
faq.answer: No. They are unlisted, but anyone with the link can open them unless password protection is enabled.

faq.question: How are passwords provided?
faq.answer: Select an existing local password file by absolute path. The script uses private header files and rejects short passwords or control characters.

faq.question: Where are owner tokens stored?
faq.answer: Tokens are saved in .claude/brewpage-history.md at the project root with mode 0600 and Git exclusion, not printed in chat.

faq.question: Does the skill build applications or detect every secret?
faq.answer: No. Publish existing static builds and review contents yourself. Archive checks identify suspicious filenames, not every secret embedded in supported files.
